PC-C1  every position-0-only arm writes something no chainable arm writes
       arms failing that: 3  S_PFX_CHG S_EXT_POP S_1BL_LEAD
       -> OK (reported, not a bar: an arm may legitimately write only shared names)
PC-C2  the register file is written by NO chainable arm      : PASS
       chainable write set carries gpr/sreg: NO
       negative control `zzz_no_such_signal` present : no
PC-C3  NON-VACUITY: injecting `gpr_n[0] = 0` into S_EA_CALC   : PASS
